goal.why: The settled goal remains change: reformat a supplied screenshot and add narration.

plan.current_state: The supplied post.png is a screenshot of the user's blog post. No derived assets or narration exist.
plan.desired_state: A 9:16 story video showing the entire blog screenshot, with English narration reading its first paragraph. The video lasts exactly as long as the narration.
plan.say: I'll reformat your screenshot into a vertical story and use English for the narration. I'll read the first paragraph and keep the story on screen for the full voice track.

steps.why: Read the actual first paragraph before creating the narration.

params.extra: Return the first paragraph verbatim and its English translation if necessary; flag any unreadable words rather than guessing.
params.prompt_or_change: Inspect the blog screenshot and transcribe the first body paragraph, excluding headings and navigation.

steps.why: Create the vertical presentation from the supplied screenshot rather than generating a replacement blog post.

params.extra: Fit the complete original screenshot within the vertical canvas without cropping; extend only the surrounding background. Preserve the screenshot as supplied rather than redrawing its text.
params.prompt_or_change: Reframe the complete screenshot as a vertical story with a simple neutral background, keeping all original content unchanged.

params.extra: Language: English; voice: clear, natural English narrator. Use only the first paragraph's English reading from paragraph.json; do not read inspection metadata. Stop if the transcription is unresolved.
params.prompt_or_change: Read the first paragraph in English at a natural, unhurried pace.

steps.why: Combine the vertical screenshot presentation and narration into one story clip.

params.extra: Use the exact measured duration of narration.wav as the clip length; hold story.png unchanged throughout.
params.prompt_or_change: Create a static vertical story using the supplied picture and the complete narration, without additional motion or content.
